title: Light Crossbow
summary: Simple ranged weapon dealing 1d8 Piercing with the BG3 Piercing Shot action.

fields.Damage: 1d8 Piercing plus Dexterity. Simple two-handed ranged weapon, 60 ft. Loading and Dippable.
fields.Piercing Shot: Action, ranged weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency. Crossbow Expert: Wounding extends this to 4 turns. The combat log shows both saves, but only the roll for the applicable duration normally matters.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
